selected_rows.behavior: Finite classical two-sample (nonoverlapping tau-bin) Allan variance for N>=2 consecutive equally spaced, tau-averaged fractional-frequency values y: sum_{i=1}^{N-1}(y[i]-y[i-1])^2 / (2*(N-1)). Exact rational in/exact rational out. Phase samples, dead time, overlapping estimators and Allan deviation are distinct contracts.
selected_rows.argument_shape: list of N>=2 tau-averaged rational fractional frequencies, equispaced with no dead time
falsifiers: Population sample variance of (0,1,0) is not the adjacent Allan estimate 1/2
Length 0 or 1 must be rejected, not divided by zero or silently returned 0
Constant common frequency offset must cancel out
nearest: NIST overlapping Allan variance is a different statistical law
selected_rows.owner_question: Can be derived via exact differences/reduce; is the named statistical aggregate independently language-visible, or better admitted as standard library?

selected_rows.behavior: For integer symbols x[i] in [0,M), M>=2 and explicit prior encoded output y[-1] in [0,M), y[i]=(x[i]+y[i-1]) mod M; return (encoded vector, last y). Empty input leaves state intact. Caller passes last y between chunks, preventing reset at chunk boundaries.
selected_rows.source_section: GNU Radio Differential Encoder, formula y[0]=(x[0]+y[-1]) % M
falsifiers: Returning x unchanged ignores accumulated prior output
Resetting previous to zero between chunks differs from a single stream
Input out of alphabet [0,M) or invalid M must be rejected
nearest: D3 arithmetic and D10 sequence accumulation
GNU Radio block implementation is an execution substrate, not an opcode identity
selected_rows.owner_question: Named modulo-state transformation can be implemented by a fold; universal computational law still needs owner evaluation.

selected_rows.behavior: For encoded input y[i] in [0,M), M>=2 and explicit prior encoded INPUT y[-1], decoded x[i]=(y[i]-y[i-1]) mod M. Return (decoded symbols, last encoded input), not last decoded output. Empty input preserves state.
selected_rows.argument_shape: (encoded symbols, modulus integer >=2, previous encoded input)
selected_rows.source_section: GNU Radio Differential Decoder, formula y[0]=(x[0]-x[-1]) % M (block's output/input notation)
falsifiers: Updating prev with DECODED output rather than prior encoded input gives wrong second symbol
On each chunk reset prev=0 loses stream-continuity inversion
Confusing (x-prev) mod M with plain signed subtraction fails wraparound
selected_rows.owner_question: Mathematically inverse to encoder with state, but different observer/entrypoint contract: owner decide independent root vs derived library.

selected_rows.behavior: For complex IQ samples z[i] and explicit previous complex input z[-1], emit z[i]*conjugate(z[i-1]); the next state is last INPUT sample. Do not normalize amplitude. For empty stream return ([],previous). Exact Gaussian rational examples; arbitrary complex magnitudes accepted.
selected_rows.result_shape: (complex samples of adjacent phase-difference products, last complex input)
falsifiers: Without conjugation, -1 multiplied by +i gives -i instead of +i
Normalizing every complex product to magnitude one violates the documented unnormalized law
Using last output as state instead of last input changes the recurrence
nearest: D10 complex numerical multiply/conjugation if present

I/Q transport remains DSP execution island
